en_title: Rockstar Confirms GTA 6 Simulates Tropical Storms and Hurricanes
subtitle: 暴雨将至
opus_summary: Rockstar确认《GTA6》将模拟热带风暴和飓风。游戏天气系统支持局部且持续的动态变化，降雨会形成彩虹与积水，风暴还将以强风、暴雨和雷电持续影响莱昂尼达的环境。

paragraphs.en: It sounds like Grand Theft Auto 6 will take open world weather effects to another level, with simulated tropical storms and hurricanes.
paragraphs.cn: 看来，《GTA6》将把开放世界中的天气效果提升到全新水平，游戏会模拟热带风暴和飓风。

paragraphs.en: We already knew that GTA 6 would have an advanced weather system of some kind. But in Game Informer's GTA 6 cover story , senior associate editor Marcus Stewart described the need for Leonida to have diverse weather, due to Florida's tendency to have wild shifts in its climate. And, it seems like Rockstar has that covered.
paragraphs.cn: 我们此前已经知道，《GTA6》会搭载某种先进的天气系统。不过，在Game Informer关于《GTA6》的封面报道中，高级副编辑Marcus Stewart表示，由于佛罗里达州的气候经常剧烈变化，莱昂尼达需要拥有多样化的天气。看来，Rockstar已经考虑到了这一点。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar vice president of art for lighting and rendering, Owen Shepherd, told Stewart, "We have re-engineered our weather system to make everything much more localized and persistent," and that "the world features new fully dynamic cloudscapes that roll across the map."
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar负责光照与渲染美术的副总裁Owen Shepherd告诉Stewart：「我们重新设计了天气系统，让所有天气现象都更加局部化且持久。」他还表示：「游戏世界拥有全新的全动态云层，它们会横跨地图移动。」

paragraphs.en: We already know that GTA 6 is going to have a map that's three times larger than the ones found in Grand Theft Auto 5 and in Red Dead Redemption 2 , so it's even more impressive that the game will be able to simulate moving storm systems. In practice, this will absolutely mean you can get localized rain showers in one area, while the next area is sunny. But while that alone wouldn't necessarily be groundbreaking, it seems like weather systems will have lasting effects on the environment.
paragraphs.cn: 我们已经知道，《GTA6》的地图面积将达到《侠盗猎车手5》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》地图的三倍，因此游戏还能模拟移动中的风暴系统，就更令人印象深刻了。实际游玩时，这意味着某个区域可能正在下局部阵雨，隔壁区域却阳光明媚。不过，单是这一点未必称得上突破性创新；但从目前的描述来看，天气系统似乎还会对环境产生持续影响。

paragraphs.en: According to Stewart, he was told that "GTA 6's rain creates realistic rainbows under the right lighting conditions, and that recently showered areas will remain wet on the ground and create persistent puddles once the storm passes." That'd be cool enough if the weather in Leonida only got as extreme as a thunderstorm but in real life, Florida is known to have more unpredictable weather.
paragraphs.cn: Stewart表示，有人告诉他：「在合适的光照条件下，《GTA6》的降雨会形成逼真的彩虹；刚下过雨的区域地面会保持湿润，风暴过后还会留下持续存在的积水。」如果莱昂尼达的天气最多只达到雷暴程度，这些效果已经够酷了。但在现实中，佛罗里达州的天气一向更加难以预测。

paragraphs.en: Luckily, GTA 6 will also have simulated tropical storms and hurricanes, which will wreak havoc on the environment. Shepherd says that these storms will have "heavy clouds, strong winds, dense atmospherics and a lot of rain combine so that everything is dripping wet, water is gushing off roof edges and lampposts, thunder rumbles and flashes of lighting light up the clouds dramatically."
paragraphs.cn: 所幸，《GTA6》还会模拟热带风暴和飓风，并对环境造成严重影响。Shepherd表示，这些风暴将带来「厚重的云层、强风、浓厚的大气效果和大量降雨，让所有东西都湿淋淋的；水流会从屋檐和路灯杆上倾泻而下，雷声轰鸣，闪电则会戏剧性地照亮云层」。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, Game Informer's cover story doesn't come with video that shows these weather systems in action, but combined with the persistent effects weather can have on the environment, my imagination is running wild. Will there be flooding in the streets? Will buildings and trees get knocked down? There are a ton of possibilities, and I already want to jump in and go storm chasing.
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，Game Informer的封面报道没有附上展示这些天气系统实际效果的视频。不过，再加上天气可能对环境造成的持续影响，我已经开始浮想联翩了。街道会不会被淹？建筑物和树木会不会被刮倒？可能性实在太多，我已经迫不及待想进入游戏追逐风暴了。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 launches on November 19, so we won't have to wait too long to see what the weather can do.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于11月19日发售，因此我们不用等太久，就能亲眼看看游戏中的天气究竟能带来什么效果。
